This maize plot is small but important for my household. Here in the North East, rains can be uncertain, so I must use fertilizer to get a good harvest — I will buy a bag of NPK and some urea when the agro-dealer comes. I also spread manure from our animals, which helps the soil stay strong. I plant the seeds I saved from last year like my mother taught me, and my daughters and I do most of the weeding ourselves, though I pay a few young men to help with clearing and ridging before planting.
